title: 布鲁克林（USS Brooklyn CL-40） — original low-poly interpretation
author: navyfield project contributors
historicalApproximation: Original procedural low-poly interpretation from general historical silhouette facts; not an exact historical reconstruction, game asset extraction, or reproduction of any source artwork. Stepped prewar bridge, two slim funnels, long forecastle and aft aviation handling deck recall USS Brooklyn CL-40. Its historical five triple-turret silhouette is intentionally not reproduced as five guns.
targetArmament: Exactly four double main mounts follow TARGET instead of the historical five triple mounts. The fifth historical turret is omitted, not represented by a fake working gun.
references: TARGET ship name and general public historical facts about nationality, class, hull, bridge, funnel and armament silhouettes; no source artwork reconstructed.
numericFiringOriginNote: Main TARGET projectile origins are the numerical mount plus lateral barrel offset (z=0), not the physical tube tip. Muzzle markers sit at physical forward tips; gameplay must retain its existing numerical firing formulas. Auxiliary manual and automatic origins are also numeric simulation points, not these cosmetic markers.
